title: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
author: Claude
description: Chickpeas simmered in a spiced tomato and coconut sauce with a lot of spinach wilted in at the end.
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach a handful at a time until wilted, season with salt and serve over the rice.
